_comment: Curated descriptions and grouping for docs/icon-guide.html. Geometry (viewBox/aspect) and usage counts are derived at build time by scripts/build-icon-guide.mjs -- do not add them here. When you add a symbol to sprite.svg, add an entry below and list its id in a group; unlisted icons still render, under an 'Other' group, with a build warning.

icons.appearance: Outlined speech-balloon screen with a notched bottom-left tail and two vertical bars inside
icons.description: The Twitch glyph for linking to live-stream jams.

icons.appearance: Solid filled circle with a slanted parallelogram knocked out of the center
icons.description: The Bandcamp mark set in a circular badge, for release and store links.

icons.appearance: Filled rounded-rectangle badge with a white play triangle in the middle
icons.description: The YouTube play-button badge for channel and video links.

icons.appearance: Rounded-square camera outline with a circle lens inside and a small solid dot at the upper right
icons.description: The Instagram camera outline for profile and Reels links.

icons.appearance: Solid eighth-note shape: a hooked flag at top right joined to a circular note head at bottom left
icons.description: The TikTok music-note glyph for short-form video links.

icons.appearance: A row of four rising vertical waveform bars beside a solid cloud shape
icons.description: The SoundCloud waveform-and-cloud mark for streaming and track links.

icons.appearance: Bold overlapping double 'P' monogram, the front P solid with a counter and a second P outline offset behind it
icons.description: The PayPal double-P mark for tip and support links.

icons.appearance: Filled rounded-square badge with a stylized white lowercase 'v' reversed out of it
icons.description: The Venmo app badge for peer-to-peer tip links.

icons.appearance: Filled squircle badge with a white dollar sign, its vertical stroke poking out top and bottom
icons.description: The Cash App badge for $cashtag tip links.

icons.appearance: Filled rectangular envelope with the flap and side creases drawn as white diagonals meeting at the center
icons.description: A closed envelope for email and contact-form links.

icons.appearance: Solid black classic telephone handset receiver, tilted diagonally
icons.description: Filled telephone-handset glyph for phone numbers, call links, or a contact section.

icons.appearance: Almond-shaped eye outline with a large filled iris and a small white pupil highlight
icons.description: Eye glyph for view counts, visibility toggles, or preview affordances.

icons.appearance: Solid black acoustic guitar silhouette angled diagonally, round soundhole, full neck and headstock
icons.description: Acoustic-guitar silhouette for rig lists, instrument tags, or gear callouts.

icons.appearance: A joined pair of bongo drums seen from the front, small and large shell, tuning lugs and rims picked out in black and white
icons.description: Paired bongo drums for hand-percussion entries in an instrument or rig lineup.

icons.appearance: A SINGLE tall conga drum in three-quarter view, tuning hardware around the head, two-tone black-and-white shell
icons.description: Single tall conga drum for hand-percussion entries; note it is one drum, not a matched pair.

icons.appearance: Detailed silhouette of a full acoustic drum kit: bass drum, snare, rack toms, floor tom, hi-hat and two cymbals on stands
icons.description: Full acoustic drum-kit silhouette for drums or rhythm-section credits.

icons.appearance: A slim melodica — long thin keyboard body with a small mouthpiece tube protruding from the left end, keys drawn in perspective
icons.description: Melodica (blown keyboard harmonica) rather than a generic piano — pick it for the melodica specifically, and use icon-synth for plain keyboards.
icons.mismatchNote: Name suggests a piano or generic keyboard, but the art is clearly a melodica with a blow mouthpiece on the left end.

icons.appearance: A full-length digital stage keyboard in perspective, long white key bed with a control panel of buttons and a small display along the left of the top surface
icons.description: Full-size electronic keyboard/stage piano for synth or keyboard rig entries.

icons.appearance: Angled mallet-percussion instrument — a row of tuned bars on a frame with two mallets laid across it diagonally
icons.description: Mallet keyboard percussion with crossed beaters for vibraphone/xylophone-style parts.

icons.appearance: Solid rounded-capsule microphone head sitting in a U-shaped yoke over a short stem and flat base
icons.description: Classic microphone glyph for vocals, recording, or live-performance labels.

icons.appearance: A round electronic hand-percussion pad with a pale striped playing surface, mounted on a tripod stand with a height-adjust clamp
icons.description: Roland HandSonic-style electronic hand-percussion pad on its tripod stand, for the looping rig's percussion slot.

icons.appearance: Rounded retro CRT television set with two rabbit-ear antennas and hollow screen
icons.description: Retro CRT television for live-stream, broadcast, or video-section links.

icons.appearance: Over-ear headphones: solid arched headband with a chunky earcup on each side
icons.description: Over-ear headphones for listening, audio, or 'hear the music' calls to action.

icons.appearance: Three vertical fader tracks with square knobs — outer two set high, middle one lower
icons.description: Vertical mixer faders for audio settings, EQ, or mix/production content.

icons.appearance: Beamed pair of eighth notes with solid oval noteheads and a thick connecting beam
icons.description: Classic beamed eighth-note pair — the generic marker for a song, track, or music link.

icons.appearance: Retro camcorder: rectangular body with hollow window, two round film reels on top, wedge lens at right
icons.description: Vintage film camcorder for video, filming, or the Videos section.

icons.appearance: Vinyl LP disc — solid black platter with concentric groove arcs and a white center label with spindle hole
icons.description: Vinyl LP record for releases, discography, or physical-music references.

icons.appearance: Solid silhouette of a guitarist mid-leap, legs split, electric guitar slung across the body
icons.description: Leaping electric-guitar player silhouette for live performance, shows, or band energy.

icons.appearance: Calendar page with two top tabs, thick border, and a 4x3 grid of solid date squares
icons.description: Wall calendar for tour dates, upcoming shows, and scheduling.

icons.appearance: Solid filled heart shape
icons.description: Solid heart for favorites, likes, support, or tip-jar affection.

icons.appearance: Solid black circle with three white curved arcs stacked inside, longest at the top — the Spotify wave mark
icons.description: Spotify's circular logo for streaming links, platform pills, and social icon strips.

icons.appearance: Solid rounded-square (squircle) tile with a pair of beamed eighth notes knocked out in white
icons.description: Apple Music's rounded app tile with a beamed note, for streaming links and platform buttons.

icons.appearance: Solid black circle containing a white ring with a right-pointing play triangle centered inside it
icons.description: YouTube Music's play-in-a-ring mark; monochrome it reads much like a generic play button, so pair it with a label.

icons.appearance: Two solid Chinese characters set side by side — 果 then 酱 — drawn as flat black lettering, wider than tall
icons.description: The 果酱 ("JAM") Chinese wordmark used as the band's brand glyph; it is a wide 2:1 lettering block, so give it an explicit width.

icons.appearance: Upright black electric bass, four in-line tuners, white pickguard, split pickup
icons.description: Cam's actual Fender-style P-bass drawn face-on and neck-up with real detail (4-in-line clover tuners, split-coil pickup with polepiece dots, knobs, screw dots) — use it in rig lineups where the generic diagonal acoustic icon-guitar would be wrong; it is tall and narrow (0.29:1), so give it real height or it reads as a sliver.

icons.appearance: Upright black Stratocaster, six in-line tuners, white pickguard, three slanted pickups
icons.description: Cam's own Strat-style electric guitar, upright and front-on with three slanted single-coils, tremolo/jack plate and screw dots — the specific-gear counterpart to the generic icon-guitar (a plain diagonal acoustic silhouette with a sound hole); at small sizes it is nearly indistinguishable from icon-rig-bass, so pair them only above ~48px.

icons.appearance: Ink line-art portrait of young man, solid black wavy hair, collar
icons.description: JAM's face as a brand/character mark — three-quarter head-and-shoulders portrait where the hair is a solid mass and the features, neck and shirt collar are open outline; it is a portrait, not gear, so use it for avatars, bylines and about-page moments, and keep it large (the thin facial lines mush below ~64px).

icons.appearance: Solid black slab keyboard in 3/4 view from above-left; white keys knocked out, black sharps as tabs, blank control panel to the right
icons.description: Cam's own stage keyboard drawn as a bare slab with no stand — reach for it when you want the instrument floating on its own (a hero mark, a bullet next to "keys"), and give it a ~2:1 wide box (viewBox 215.6x105.9) since it is much wider than tall.

icons.appearance: Two-way PA cabinet (small tweeter ring above big woofer ring) on a splayed tripod stand; drivers sit left of center, long leg trails down-right
icons.description: The left half of Cam's stereo PA pair — a real monitor-on-a-tripod silhouette, tall (112.9x249, ~1:2.2), meant to flank content or a stage diagram opposite icon-rig-speaker-right, which is its exact mirror.

icons.appearance: Identical PA cabinet and tripod, mirrored: drivers sit right of center, long leg trails down-left
icons.description: Pixel-for-pixel the horizontal mirror of icon-rig-speaker-left (verified by flip-compare), same tall 112.9x249 box — pick it for the right-hand side of a flanking pair so the two lean toward each other instead of repeating.
